rationale: All five findings from code-review-final are resolved. The fix-up diff introduces no new high-risk patterns. Standards check passes on the new commit (EPMCDME-5383: Fix ZIP upload security and robustness gaps from code review).

standards_review.notes: Fix-up commit uses EPMCDME-5383: description format.
Type hints present on chunks list, consistent exception patterns, no dead code.
CR-001 resolved: info.file_size no longer used; actual bytes accumulated in 64KB chunks via zf.open(info).

finding_status.notes: info.file_size accumulation removed. Replaced with zf.open(info) chunk reading; total_size += len(chunk) tracks actual decompressed bytes and raises 422 mid-read if limit exceeded.
_ZIP_MAX_FILE_COUNT = 1000 constant added. Guard if len(result) >= _ZIP_MAX_FILE_COUNT raises HTTP 422 before reading the entry that would exceed the cap.
Both ZIP branches (CREATE path in index.py and UPDATE path in upload_and_prepare_files) now call validate_json_file/_validate_json_file for .json entries before write_file.
Both paths now call _expand_zip_file, capture the result, and raise HTTP 422 if the result list is empty before any write_file calls.
Guard extended to if not flat_name or flat_name in (".", ".."): continue. Test test_expand_zip_file_skips_dot_and_dotdot_entries confirms both entries are skipped.
